book.method: Original authoring from topic anchors after readable page-image review. Source numeric guidance is not promoted into universal cabinet, appliance, electrical, gas, accessibility, ventilation or ergonomic specifications. No source image is copied into learner assets.

verified_scope: The document is specific to this built-in appliance.
Connection without a plug is assigned to a licensed professional.
Section21.3 addresses cabinet backs and ventilation paths; these are not just external-envelope dimensions.
Installation combinations and clearances are model-specific.
Recirculation operation over a gas hob is distinguished from ventilation of the room.
Installation/maintenance and electrical work are assigned to appropriately qualified or authorized personnel.
Overall room ventilation and interactions require competent review.

boundary: Services lessons teach spatial coordination and evidence/approval ownership, not electrical/gas/plumbing operation or connection procedures.
